items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee's name is Joe Thomas. The interviewer mentions Mr. Davioni in the context of a band with Mr. Gustadt. The interviewee does not speak or respond in the provided context, so no personal relationship is established.

ctx.x: Oh, well, we spelled it wrong then.
It's Gustadt. And they had three trumpet players, three trumpet pieces there -- Mr. Gustadt and Mr. Davioni.
